t: On the Case: Mystery In The Desert
d: When an innocent couple is murdered execution style in the Arizona desert it marks the beginning of a 50 year search for the truth. Who really killed them and why?  After decades of investigation  the controversial case remains shrouded in mystery

t: On the Case: Sirens in the Night
d: Paula takes a look at the shocking discovery of a mysterious young woman who is found in the ashes of a fire.

t: On the Case: Heartbreak in the Heartland
d: A quiet Midwestern community is rocked by a gruesome triple homicide. The unspeakable tragedy robs one man of his mother, grandmother and 5 year old son.

t: On the Case: Trail of Betrayal
d: After missing newlyweds are found murdered, family members and friends point fingers at each other, leading investigators to believe someone close to the victims is responsible for their deaths.

t: On the Case: A Deadly Betrayal
d: A beloved father of two is executed after a friendly poker game.  Were the stakes too high?  Or would police find the truth much closer to home?

t: On the Case: Deadly Riddle
d: Nine days after 11-year-old Mary Stiles goes missing while trick-or-treating, a letter arrives at the police station leading investigators to Stiles' body; then, investigators must decipher a series of riddles before the killer strikes again.

t: On the Case: Last Dance
d: A woman's walk home from a night out at a dance club ends in a brutal murder.

t: On the Case: Stabbed in the Heart
d: A beloved mother of four is stabbed to death in her bathroom.  A mysterious v shaped wound on her forehead finally leads police to her killer decades later.

t: On the Case: Murder at Sunrise
d: A beautiful young mother is found murdered while walking her dogs. Investigators suspect her killer is someone she knew. Twenty-six years latter police make an arrest but is he the right man?

t: On the Case: Left in the Dark
d: When a beautiful young graduate student is found stabbed to death, detectives must determine if the murder was a crime of passion or a brutal attack by a violent intruder.

t: On the Case: Deceiving Appearances
d: Police suspect a mysterious double homicide is not what it appears to be.

t: On the Case: Blood and Betrayal
d: A military police officer is found murdered in her own home, sending police on a twisted journey for answers.

t: On the Case: A Long Journey To Justice
d: When a young college student is found murdered on the side of road, it is the start of a tormenting 26 year journey to justice for her family.

t: On the Case: A Mystery on Cherry Hill
d: When a beautiful young woman vanishes without a trace, it may take another tragedy before police will be able to solve the mystery of her disappearance.

t: On the Case: Blood, Sweat and Tears
d: A cold case team reopens the investigation into the murder of 36-year-old Linda Robinson who is savagely murdered while her seven-year-old niece is asleep in the next room.

t: On the Case: A Murder at Loose Chippings
d: After a wealthy couple is found dead in their stately Virginia home, investigators are taken on a wild journey around the globe before they uncover the shocking truth.

t: On the Case: Profile of a Killer
d: When a beautiful young woman is found murdered in the basement of her brand new home, Police are forced to use cutting edge techniques to solve a terrifying mystery.

t: On the Case: Blurred Truth
d: Paula Zahn explores a chilling crime mystery involving a murdered mother of five and speaks to the individuals directly involved in the case

t: On the Case: Scent of a Killer
d: The investigation into Sandra Iverson's stabbing death goes cold until a police canine team uncovers a trail leading them to an unlikely young suspect.

t: On the Case: Under Suspicion
d: When a 26 year old wife and mother vanishes, investigators wonder if she simply just ran away or if it was something far more sinister. The search for answers would take nearly a decade and lead her family on a dark journey they could never have imagined.
